{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm revenue has commas
print("Revenue values with commas:")
print(df[df['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False)]['revenue'].head())

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"\nNumber of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")
print(qa_orders[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'status', 'revenue_clean']])

# Remove QA orders and refunded orders
df_clean = df_clean = df[(df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check the resulting shape
print(f"\nRows after removing QA and refunded orders: {len(df_clean)}")

# Now cross-tabulate channel vs segment to check confounding
print("\nChannel by customer_segment:")
print(pd.crosstab(df_clean['channel'], df_clean['customer_segment']))"}
